decisions.statement: A compiled worker has the commit the build put in.
The commit is put in at build time by the bundler rather than read at run time.
A worker running from source reports itself as dev.
The bundler replaces a bare name rather than a path.
Moving this file does not change the commit the bundler puts in.
No test here reaches the branch the bundler puts in.

definition: the version the watcher worker reports itself as
